name: MenuPricer
description: MenuPricer is an AI-powered menu pricing tool that helps restaurant owners, cafe operators, food truck vendors, caterers, and bakery owners calculate the correct selling price for any menu item. Type a dish name and AI estimates ingredient costs, then MenuPricer calculates food cost percentage, gross margin, and a recommended price across three tiers: Budget, Standard, and Premium. It also calculates delivery platform pricing offsets for DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub.
category: Restaurant menu pricing and food cost calculator software

pricing.free: Up to 5 dishes, no credit card required
pricing.pro_monthly: $9/month for unlimited dishes, batch pricing, and PDF export

keyFeatures: AI ingredient cost estimation from just a dish name, no written recipe required
Three pricing tiers per dish (Budget, Standard, Premium) with food cost % and margin
Delivery platform commission calculator (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub)
Branded PDF export for individual dishes or a full menu
Multi-currency support: USD, CNY, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD
15 free standalone calculators (food cost, recipe cost, markup, profit margin, bakery, catering, coffee shop, food truck, and more)
